title: Jellyfish reading a book
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='bellGlow' cx='50%' cy='40%' r='60%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#FFB3E6'/>
      <stop offset='70%' stop-color='#FF6FC8'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#C43A93'/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>
  <!-- bell / dome of jellyfish -->
  <path d='M22 40 C22 20, 78 20, 78 40 C78 48, 70 52, 50 52 C30 52, 22 48, 22 40 Z' fill='url(#bellGlow)'/>
  <!-- bell inner highlight -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='34' rx='20' ry='10' fill='#FFD1F0' opacity='0.6'/>
  <!-- tentacles fluttering -->
  <path d='M30 50 C28 62, 34 68, 30 78' stroke='#FF8FD6' stroke-width='4' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M40 50 C38 64, 44 70, 41 82' stroke='#FF8FD6' stroke-width='4' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M60 50 C62 64, 56 70, 59 82' stroke='#FF8FD6' stroke-width='4' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M70 50 C72 62, 66 68, 70 78' stroke='#FF8FD6' stroke-width='4' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- eyes on bell -->
  <circle cx='43' cy='36' r='4' fill='#3B1E5C'/>
  <circle cx='57' cy='36' r='4' fill='#3B1E5C'/>
  <circle cx='44' cy='34.5' r='1.4' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='34.5' r='1.4' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <!-- little smile -->
  <path d='M46 43 Q50 46 54 43' stroke='#7A1F63' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- book held below -->
  <g>
    <!-- book cover left -->
    <path d='M30 62 L50 66 L50 86 L30 82 Z' fill='#2E7DD1'/>
    <!-- book cover right -->
    <path d='M50 66 L70 62 L70 82 L50 86 Z' fill='#1F5FA8'/>
    <!-- pages left -->
    <path d='M33 64 L49 67.5 L49 83 L33 79.5 Z' fill='#F4F8FF'/>
    <!-- pages right -->
    <path d='M51 67.5 L67 64 L67 79.5 L51 83 Z' fill='#DCE8FA'/>
    <!-- page lines left -->
    <line x1='36' y1='69' x2='47' y2='71.5' stroke='#9DB9DC' stroke-width='1.3'/>
    <line x1='36' y1='73' x2='47' y2='75.5' stroke='#9DB9DC' stroke-width='1.3'/>
    <line x1='36' y1='77' x2='47' y2='79.5' stroke='#9DB9DC' stroke-width='1.3'/>
    <!-- page lines right -->
    <line x1='53' y1='71.5' x2='64' y2='69' stroke='#9DB9DC' stroke-width='1.3'/>
    <line x1='53' y1='75.5' x2='64' y2='73' stroke='#9DB9DC' stroke-width='1.3'/>
    <line x1='53' y1='79.5' x2='64' y2='77' stroke='#9DB9DC' stroke-width='1.3'/>
    <!-- spine -->
    <line x1='50' y1='66' x2='50' y2='86' stroke='#143E70' stroke-width='2'/>
  </g>
  <!-- two small tentacle arms touching the book -->
  <path d='M44 52 C46 58, 44 60, 40 63' stroke='#FF8FD6' stroke-width='3.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M56 52 C54 58, 56 60, 60 63' stroke='#FF8FD6' stroke-width='3.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
